notablePrerequisites:
Assault Suit attached to Marjhan.
A player controls no Islands.
description:
If needed, give control of Marjhan to an opponent who controls no Islands.
When Marjhan's controller controls no Islands, Marjhan triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Marjhan cannot be sacrificed due to Assault Suit.
Marjhan triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.
